items.q: What dosage forms does Swanya manufacture?
items.a: Sterile liquids filled on Form-Fill-Seal (FFS) machines: Sterile Water for Injection (5–30 ml vials), Normal Saline solution (10 ml vials), Respules (1–5 ml solution and suspension vials) and FFS ampoules. Both clear solutions and suspensions are manufactured, in separate areas.

items.q: What is Form-Fill-Seal and why does it matter?
items.a: FFS is a closed process in which the plastic container is formed, filled and hermetically sealed inside one machine within seconds. It removes glass, separate stoppers and manual handling from the sterile step, which lowers particulate and contamination risk.

items.q: What batch sizes can you run?
items.a: Manufacturing vessels support batch sizes from 500 litres up to 2,500 litres.

items.q: How is Water for Injection produced and controlled?
items.a: Purified Water feeds a multi-column distillation still supplied with pure steam. WFI is stored at 80 °C and above, protected by a vent filter, and circulated continuously through the distribution loop. The loop is sampled routinely for conductivity, pH, pyrogen (bacterial endotoxin) and microbial limits.
Autoclaving, sterile filtration and Sterilization-in-Place (SIP). Sterilising-grade filters undergo online filter integrity testing.
